theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W C : Set (Euclid P)) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (μ : Measure (Euclid P)) (ξ : Euclid P → MultiVector P n), MeasurableSet W → MeasurableSet C → C ⊆ W → μ W < ∞ → T.massOn W = μ W → (∀ (x : Euclid P) (α : Covector (Euclid P) n), |ξ x α| ≤ covectorEuclideanNorm α) → (∀ ω : TestFormOn U n, T ω = ∫ x, ξ x ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n) x) ∂μ) → (∀ᵐ x ∂μ, x ∈ C → ξ x = 0) → μ C = 0
